v: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to the fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
A sense of awe came over everyone, and the apostles performed many wonders and signs.
All the believers were together and had everything in common.
Selling their possessions and goods, they shared with anyone who was in need.
With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,
praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

paras: In the early days of the church, the people who believed in Jesus were always spending time together. Every single day they would gather at the main temple and go to each other’s house to eat meals together and take the Lord’s Supper.
These believers really loved and cared for one another! They willingly shared what they had, and were even selling their own possessions so they could give money to anyone who was in need.
And whenever they gathered together, they listened closely as Jesus’ closest followers taught them God’s Word. They would also spend lots of time praying and worshiping God together.

The people around these believers saw all that was happening and thought very highly of these believers. Not only that, the people saw the miracles that God was doing through Jesus’ closest followers and they were completely in awe! And because of all of this, every day more and more people were believing in Jesus and being cleansed of their sins.
